series.title: Ancient Immortal Doctor Of The Metropolis
series.synopsis: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car driver to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he was proficient in medicine, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beauties.
